sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But not an opera, I think.
sentences.zh: 但我想还没有歌剧。

sentences.en: So anyway, they have not been wrecked.
sentences.zh: 所以无论如何，他们没有遇险沉没。

sentences.en: So they continue and they approach Toulon.
sentences.zh: 于是他们继续前进，并接近土伦。

sentences.en: It is clear the French are long gone from Toulon.
sentences.zh: 很明显，法军早已离开土伦。

sentences.en: So now, basically, they're looking for a needle in a haystack.
sentences.zh: 所以现在，基本上他们是在大海捞针。

sentences.en: They are.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I mean, the huge expanse of the Mediterranean to find this fleet is going to be really tough.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在地中海的广阔水域中寻找这支舰队将非常艰难。

sentences.en: They then spot a sort of sail.
sentences.zh: 然后他们发现了一种船帆。

sentences.en: It's a brig and it's come from St. Vincent.
sentences.zh: 那是一艘从圣文森特来的双桅纵帆船。

sentences.en: He has sent, of all people, Hardy, Thomas Masterman Hardy, who's now a Commodore.
sentences.zh: 他派出的竟然是哈迪，托马斯·马斯特曼·哈迪，他现在是一名准将。

sentences.en: And Hardy says, we've heard intelligence.
sentences.zh: 哈迪说，我们听到了情报。

sentences.en: We have news.
sentences.zh: 我们有消息了。

sentences.en: This enormous fleet has been spotted heading towards Italy.
sentences.zh: 这支庞大的舰队被发现正驶向意大利。

sentences.en: At least a dozen ships of the line, hundreds of transports.
sentences.zh: 至少有十几艘战列舰，数以百计的运兵船。

sentences.en: The orders have changed.
sentences.zh: 命令变了。

sentences.en: We want you to intercept this fleet and we will be sending reinforcements for you to do this.
sentences.zh: 我们要你拦截这支舰队，我们会派增援来协助你完成任务。

sentences.en: So your old mate, Thomas Troubridge of Tenerife fame, is on his way.
sentences.zh: 所以你老搭档、因特内里费岛之战而闻名的托马斯·特劳布里奇正在赶来。

sentences.en: Hates the French.
sentences.zh: 痛恨法国人。

sentences.en: He does hate the French with a passion with 11 more ships.
sentences.zh: 他确实对法国人恨之入骨，还带着另外11艘军舰。

sentences.en: And, you know, go for it now.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，现在就放手去干吧。

sentences.en: This is a campaign of annihilation.
sentences.zh: 这是一场歼灭战。

sentences.en: And so he's told that he's being sent the elite of the Navy of England.
sentences.zh: 因此他被告知将获得英国海军的精锐力量。

sentences.en: But there is one big drawback, which is that there's a lack of cruisers, an order of ship that had begun to be constructed the previous year and are designed for speed.
sentences.zh: 但有一个重大缺陷，那就是缺乏巡洋舰——这种前一年开始建造、专为速度而设计的船只。

sentences.en: And obviously they would be ideal if you're looking for a fleet.
sentences.zh: 很显然，如果你在搜寻舰队，它们将是理想的选择。

sentences.en: And St. Vincent actually sends Nelson nine of these cruisers.
sentences.zh: 圣文森特实际上派给纳尔逊九艘这种巡洋舰。

sentences.en: But for kind of concatenation of reasons, only one reaches him.
sentences.zh: 但由于种种原因的交织，只有一艘到达了他身边。

sentences.en: And so this will be a real problem for Nelson over the next few weeks because he just lacks the resources necessary to find an expedition.
sentences.zh: 因此，这将在接下来的几周里成为纳尔逊的一个真正问题，因为他缺乏搜寻远征军所需的资源。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So Hina has 14 fighting ships and they are, as you said, Tom, they're the elite of the Royal Navy.
sentences.zh: 所以希纳有14艘战舰，而且正如你所说，汤姆，它们是皇家海军的精锐。

sentences.en: And he's also got supplies for three months.
sentences.zh: 他还备有三个月的补给品。

sentences.en: So bread and oranges and beef and all that stuff.
sentences.zh: 有面包、橙子、牛肉以及诸如此类的东西。

sentences.en: Literal bullocks.
sentences.zh: 字面意义上的公牛。

sentences.en: Literal bullocks.
sentences.zh: 字面意义上的公牛。

sentences.en: We have Troubridge in the Culloden.
sentences.zh: 我们有乘坐“卡洛登号”的特劳布里奇。

sentences.en: We have Henry d'Estaer Derby in the Bellerophon.
sentences.zh: 我们有乘坐“柏勒罗丰号”的亨利·德埃斯特·德比。

sentences.en: Thomas Foley in Goliath.
sentences.zh: 乘坐“歌利亚号”的托马斯·弗利。

sentences.en: These are the cream of the crop of the Royal Navy.
sentences.zh: 这些都是皇家海军中的佼佼者。

sentences.en: These are people at Nelson's level, really.
sentences.zh: 说真的，这些人与纳尔逊处于同一水平。

sentences.en: You know, brilliant commanders in extremely well-disciplined, well-trained ships.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们是杰出的指挥官，统率着纪律严明、训练有素的舰艇。

sentences.en: So like the cream of the English peerage at the Battle of Agincourt, Dominic?
sentences.zh: 就像阿金库尔战役中的英国贵族精英一样吗，多米尼克？

sentences.en: Well, that's the comparison, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这就是那种对比，不是吗？

sentences.en: That is the comparison because we talked in the very first episode about how Nelson clearly must have loved Shakespeare at school because he's got this absolute fixation on Henry V and on the idea of the Band of Brothers.
sentences.zh: 这确实是那种对比，因为我们在第一集中谈到过，纳尔逊在学校时显然一定很喜欢莎士比亚，因为他有一种对亨利五世以及“兄弟连”概念的绝对执念。

sentences.en: And this now, the reason we've mentioned all these people, is that this is the Band of Brothers.
sentences.zh: 而现在，我们提到所有这些人的原因，就是因为这就是“兄弟连”。

sentences.en: He has this romantic yearning, I guess, that these are like, you know, Alexander the Great's companions or Henry V's paladins before Agincourt.
sentences.zh: 我猜他有一种浪漫的渴望，觉得这些人就像亚历山大大帝的同伴，或是阿金库尔战役前亨利五世的帕拉丁骑士一样。

sentences.en: These are the people who will stand together in the darkest hour, you know, shoulder to shoulder, all of this kind of thing, which Nelson absolutely believes in.
sentences.zh: 这些人将在最黑暗的时刻并肩作战，肩并肩，诸如此类纳尔逊绝对深信不疑的事情。

sentences.en: And it is said of Nelson that there was never an admiral who was more open to being approached by his fellow captains.
sentences.zh: 人们对纳尔逊的评价是，从来没有哪位海军上将像他那样平易近人、乐于接见手下的舰长们。

sentences.en: Yeah, because his way of working is he will have them over, won't he, for dinner and stuff.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为他的工作方式是会邀请他们过来吃晚饭什么的。

sentences.en: A touch of Nelson.
sentences.zh: 纳尔逊风格。

sentences.en: Exactly, the Nelson touch.
sentences.zh: 没错，这就是纳尔逊风格。

sentences.en: Over their kind of spotted dog and kind of steak pudding or whatever, they will talk on and on about the tactics and the plan.
sentences.zh: 在享用他们的斑点狗布丁、牛排布丁或其他什么东西时，他们会滔滔不绝地讨论战术和计划。

sentences.en: He's very open and very generous, which is unusual.
sentences.zh: 他非常坦诚且慷慨，这很不寻常。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, obviously, there is a hierarchy and they do defer to him.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，显而易见，这里存在等级制度，他们也确实听从他的指挥。

sentences.en: But by the standards of the time, he's much less strict.
sentences.zh: 但以当时的标准来看，他要开明得多。

sentences.en: He wants to hear what they've got to say.
sentences.zh: 他想倾听他们的想法。

sentences.en: And obviously, they have a lot to discuss because they don't know where this armament is heading and they've got to try and work it out, haven't they?
sentences.zh: 显然，他们有很多事情要讨论，因为他们不知道这支武装力量要开往哪里，必须设法弄清楚，不是吗？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: So here are the options.
sentences.zh: 所以目前的选项有这些。

sentences.en: It could well be heading for southern Italy to basically snuff out the kingdom of Naples.
sentences.zh: 它很有可能是前往南意大利，以便彻底消灭那不勒斯王国。

sentences.en: It could head to Greece.
sentences.zh: 它可能会前往希腊。

sentences.en: Greece is part of the Ottoman Empire, but a lot of the Ottoman Empire feels like it's ripe for the plucking.
sentences.zh: 希腊是奥斯曼帝国的一部分，但奥斯曼帝国的许多地方感觉就像是唾手可得的肥肉。

sentences.en: So it could be going to Greece.
sentences.zh: 所以它可能去希腊。

sentences.en: There's talk of Constantinople.
sentences.zh: 还有人谈到君士坦丁堡。

sentences.en: There is also talk of going further east, going southeast towards Egypt.
sentences.zh: 也有人谈到去更东边，向东南方向前往埃及。

sentences.en: You mentioned Egypt earlier.
sentences.zh: 你刚才提到了埃及。

sentences.en: There are some rumours that the French have been lining up scholars and scientists and they've got some crazy operation in mind.
sentences.zh: 有一些传言称法国人一直在集结学者和科学家，他们正在酝酿某种疯狂的行动。

sentences.en: Very far-fetched, though, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 不过，这未免太牵强了吧？

sentences.en: Very far-fetched.
sentences.zh: 非常牵强。

sentences.en: Go all the way to Egypt?
sentences.zh: 一路去到埃及？

sentences.en: I mean, very unlikely.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这不太可能。

sentences.en: I mean, there are even rumours that the French have dispatched agents to India and that there is something brewing, perhaps an attack on the East India Company.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，甚至还有传言说法国人已经向印度派遣了特工，有什么阴谋正在酝酿中，也许是对东印度公司的袭击。

sentences.en: I mean, it's a dream mad in the way that Alexander the Great's dreams were mad.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个疯狂的梦想，就像亚历山大大帝的梦想一样疯狂。

sentences.en: I mean, just wholly implausible.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，简直完全不可信。

sentences.en: Exactly, Tom.
sentences.zh: 一点没错，汤姆。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: So everybody back home in Britain is following this.
sentences.zh: 所以英国本土的每个人都在关注这件事。

sentences.en: I mean, they're following us weeks behind at one remove.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们落后了好几周，隔着一层在关注。

sentences.en: So they're reading the newspapers and there is a sort of an immense nervousness.
sentences.zh: 因此他们正在阅读报纸，弥漫着一种极度紧张的气氛。

sentences.en: You know, Fanny pouring over the papers for reports of her husband.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，范妮在报纸上急切地搜寻有关她丈夫的报道。

sentences.en: The people at the Admiralty waiting all the time.
sentences.zh: 海军部的人们时刻在等待。

sentences.en: Where is this armament heading?
sentences.zh: 这支武装力量究竟开往何方？

sentences.en: One of them writes, an Admiralty official writes, on the success or destruction of Bonaparte's fleet, an event of great moment, not to us alone, but to all Europe may depend.
sentences.zh: 其中一人写道，一名海军部官员写道：波拿巴舰队的成功或毁灭，这一重大事件，不仅关乎我们，也可能关乎整个欧洲。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太惊人了。

sentences.en: But, you know, they can't find it.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，他们找不到它。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: It seems to have vanished into the air.
sentences.zh: 它似乎凭空消失了。

sentences.en: And John Sugden in his, I mean, incomparable biography of Nelson sums it up gloriously.
sentences.zh: 约翰·萨格登在他那部（我的意思是）无可比拟的纳尔逊传记中对其进行了精彩的总结。

sentences.en: So he writes, mysteriously, no one had heard a reliable word about the French.
sentences.zh: 因此他写道：神秘的是，没有人听到关于法军的任何可靠消息。

sentences.en: They seem to be phantasms capable of materializing and dematerializing at their pleasure.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎成了幻影，能够随心所欲地实体化和虚体化。

sentences.en: It's like something out of science fiction.
sentences.zh: 这就像科幻小说里的情节。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: A kind of alien fleet with, you know, invisibility shields or something.
sentences.zh: 某种带有隐形护盾之类的外星舰队。

sentences.en: That's exactly what it is.
sentences.zh: 情况正是如此。

sentences.en: Because the Mediterranean is a million square miles of sea.
sentences.zh: 因为地中海是一百万平方英里的海洋。

sentences.en: And wherever they go, they hear rumors, but nothing's certain.
sentences.zh: 无论他们走到哪里，都会听到传闻，但没有什么是确定的。

sentences.en: They go to Naples and Truebridge goes ashore to consult with the British envoy in Naples, Sir William Hamilton.
sentences.zh: 他们去了那不勒斯，特劳布里奇上岸与英国驻那不勒斯特使威廉·汉密尔顿爵士进行磋商。

sentences.en: He's there for two hours and then he comes back to the ship and he says, Hamilton is sure of it.
sentences.zh: 他在那里待了两个小时，然后回到船上说，汉密尔顿对此坚信不疑。

sentences.en: They're heading for Sicily.
sentences.zh: 他们正驶向西西里岛。

sentences.en: They sail south through the Straits of Messina, past Etna, smoking on the horizon.
sentences.zh: 他们向南穿过墨西拿海峡，驶过地平线上烟雾缭绕的埃特纳火山。

sentences.en: They spot another brig.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了另一艘双桅纵帆船。

sentences.en: And the captain of this brig says, I've heard reports of French flags flying over Malta.
sentences.zh: 这艘双桅纵帆船的船长说：我听到过有报道说法国国旗在马耳他上空飘扬。

sentences.en: But, so they've taken Malta.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们占领了马耳他。

sentences.en: And that's crucial, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这至关重要，不是吗？

sentences.en: Because Malta is the pivot between the east and the western half of the Mediterranean.
sentences.zh: 因为马耳他是地中海东部和西部之间的枢纽。

sentences.en: So whoever controls Malta essentially controls the hinge on which sea routes through the Mediterranean operate.
sentences.zh: 所以谁控制了马耳他，基本上就控制了地中海海上航线运作的枢纽。

sentences.en: Slightly mixing my metaphors there, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想我这里稍微有点混淆比喻了。

sentences.en: But you know what I mean.
sentences.zh: 但你明白我的意思。

sentences.en: No, I think it's a powerful description.
sentences.zh: 不，我认为这是一个很有力量的描述。

sentences.en: Thank you, Dominic.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，多米尼克。

sentences.en: So Bonaparte has moved on.
sentences.zh: 所以波拿巴已经前行了。

sentences.en: He's gone past Malta, Greece, Constantinople, Egypt.
sentences.zh: 他已经经过了马耳他、希腊、君士坦丁堡、埃及。

sentences.en: Why would he make for Egypt?
sentences.zh: 他为什么要驶向埃及？

sentences.en: I mean, this is the question that must be in Nelson's mind.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这一定是纳尔逊脑海中的疑问。

sentences.en: Egypt is technically a province of the Ottoman Empire.
sentences.zh: 埃及在名义上是奥斯曼帝国的一个省。

sentences.en: But in practice, it has been run for centuries by the Mamelukes.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，几个世纪以来它一直由马穆鲁克统治。

sentences.en: So they're the descendants of the Turkic slave soldiers of the Ottomans.
sentences.zh: 所以他们是奥斯曼帝国的突厥奴隶士兵的后裔。

sentences.en: On paper, the Mamelukes are neutral.
sentences.zh: 从纸面上看，马穆鲁克是中立的。

sentences.en: But if Bonaparte could get Egypt, that basically gives him the whole of the southeastern Mediterranean,
sentences.zh: 但如果波拿巴能够占领埃及，这基本上就给了他整个东南地中海的控制权，

sentences.en: and it also means it gives him ports on the Red Sea from which the French could strike east to hoover up the British trade with India.
sentences.zh: 这也意味着它为他提供了红海上的港口，法国人可以从这里向东突袭，蚕食英国对印度的贸易。

sentences.en: So maybe that stuff, those reports about French agents out there in the east moving through the bazaars.
sentences.zh: 所以也许那些东西，那些关于法国特工在东方集市中穿梭的报道。

sentences.en: They're mastery of tongues.
sentences.zh: 他们精通各种语言。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Mastery of disguise.
sentences.zh: 精于伪装。

sentences.en: Maybe there's something in it.
sentences.zh: 也许这其中确有其事。

sentences.en: It's very Green Mantle.
sentences.zh: 这非常像《绿斗篷》里的情节。

sentences.en: It's very John Buck and all this, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这很有一点约翰·巴克的风格，不是吗？

sentences.en: So Nelson has this crucial conference.
sentences.zh: 所以纳尔逊召开了这场至关重要的会议。

sentences.en: He invites the four captains to whom he's closeSt.
sentences.zh: 他邀请了四位与他关系密切的舰长。

sentences.en: That is Truebridge, Ball, Summeray, and Derby aboard the vanguard.
sentences.zh: 他们分别是“先锋”号上的特鲁布里奇、鲍尔、萨默雷和德比。

sentences.en: And he says, right, we have three possible courses of action here.
sentences.zh: 他说，好吧，我们现在有三种可能的行动方案。

sentences.en: We could attack Malta, turf out the French garrison and try to retake Malta.
sentences.zh: 我们可以进攻马耳他，驱逐法国守军，设法重新夺回马耳他。

sentences.en: But that means the armament is sailing around and we don't know what it's doing.
sentences.zh: 但这意味着舰队会四处航行，而我们不知道它在做什么。

sentences.en: We could head back towards Sicily and Naples in case this is all the ruse and that's what the French have in mind.
sentences.zh: 我们可以调头驶向西西里和那不勒斯，以防这完全是个计谋，而这正是法国人的意图。

sentences.en: Or we could turn south towards Egypt.
sentences.zh: 或者我们可以向南驶向埃及。

sentences.en: And he says to the other captains, and I quote, should the armament be gone to Alexandria and get safe there?
sentences.zh: 他对其他舰长说，我引述一下：“如果舰队去了亚历山大港并在那里安全靠港了呢？”

sentences.en: Our possessions in India are probably loSt.
sentences.zh: “我们在印度的领地可能就保不住了。”

sentences.en: Do you think we had better push for that place?
sentences.zh: “你们认为我们最好去那里争取一下吗？”

sentences.en: And then he hands out, it's a very kind of dramatic moment, four pieces of paper.
sentences.zh: 接着他分发了四张纸，这是一个非常戏剧化的时刻。

sentences.en: And he says, each of you write your answer on this piece of paper.
sentences.zh: 他说，你们每个人把答案写在这张纸上。

sentences.en: And one by one, they write the same word, Alexandria.
sentences.zh: 他们一个接一个地写下了同一个词：亚历山大港。

sentences.en: It's a brilliant moment.
sentences.zh: 这是一个绝妙的时刻。

sentences.en: So off to Alexandria, they head and the wind is behind them and they make tremendous speed.
sentences.zh: 于是他们朝亚历山大港进发，顺风行船，速度极快。

sentences.en: And they don't know it, but as they're heading, they pass perilously close to the French armament.
sentences.zh: 他们自己并不知道，但在航行途中，他们与法国舰队擦肩而过，险象环生。

sentences.en: I mean, unbelievably close.
sentences.zh: 我是说，近得难以置信。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Maybe a couple further miles south and they would have seen it.
sentences.zh: 也许再往南开几英里，他们就能看见了。

sentences.en: But anyway, on they go.
sentences.zh: 但无论如何，他们继续前进。

sentences.en: And a week later on the 29th of June, they sail into Alexandria, one of the most romantic, historic cities on the whole of the Mediterranean.
sentences.zh: 一周后，即6月29日，他们驶入亚历山大港，这是整个地中海最具浪漫色彩、最具历史底蕴的城市之一。

sentences.en: I mean, imagine that, you know, they are in the great drama of the age themselves, but they're against a backdrop that couldn't be bettered.
sentences.zh: 我是说，想象一下，你知道的，他们自己身处这个时代的宏大戏剧中，却有着无可挑剔的背景衬托。

sentences.en: Well, we've already mentioned Alexander, haven't we?
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们已经提到过亚历山大大帝了，不是吗？

sentences.en: I mean, this is founded by Alexander the Great.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这是由亚历山大大帝建立的。

sentences.en: It's where Antony Cleopatra hung out.
sentences.zh: 这里是安东尼和克利奥帕特拉厮混过的地方。

sentences.en: It's one of the great cities of Christianity and Islam.
sentences.zh: 它是基督教和伊斯兰教的伟大城市之一。

sentences.en: I mean, incredible.
sentences.zh: 我是说，太不可思议了。

sentences.en: For somebody who conceives of himself as an operatic figure, as the hero of a great melodrama, what a moment.
sentences.zh: 对于一个将自己视为歌剧人物、伟大大悲剧英雄的人来说，这是多么美妙的时刻。

sentences.en: But to be a hero of a great melodrama, you don't want to look like an idiot.
sentences.zh: 但要成为一出伟大悲剧的英雄，你可不想让自己看起来像个白痴。

sentences.en: And Nelson looks like an idiot because there's no sign of the French.
sentences.zh: 而纳尔逊看起来就像个白痴，因为根本没有法国人的踪影。

sentences.en: They've called it wrong.
sentences.zh: 他们猜错了。

sentences.en: They arrive and there's nothing.
sentences.zh: 他们抵达时，什么也没有。

sentences.en: He sends Hardy ashore to talk to the locals and Hardy comes back and he says, nothing.
sentences.zh: 他派哈迪上岸与当地人交谈，哈迪回来后说，什么也没有。

sentences.en: No sign of the French.
sentences.zh: 没有法国人的踪迹。

sentences.en: There's been no reports of the French.
sentences.zh: 没有任何关于法国人的报告。

sentences.en: I mean, what a devastating moment for Nelson.
sentences.zh: 我是说，对纳尔逊来说这是多么毁灭性的时刻。

sentences.en: Crushing.
sentences.zh: 简直是灭顶之灾。

sentences.en: Because time is of the essence.
sentences.zh: 因为时间就是生命。

sentences.en: He doesn't have that many supplies.
sentences.zh: 他没有带那么多补给。

sentences.en: And getting supplies in what is a French lake is so difficult.
sentences.zh: 在一个形同法国内湖的地方获取补给是极其困难的。

sentences.en: And he knows that every day lost is a day that the French could be, you know, laying siege to Constantinople, laying siege to Naples.
sentences.zh: 他知道，失去的每一天，都是法国人可能在对君士坦丁堡或那不勒斯围城的一天。

sentences.en: Who knows?
sentences.zh: 谁知道呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He has made a terrible mistake and they are probably heading to either Constantinople or Naples and he must hurry.
sentences.zh: 他犯了一个严重的错误，他们可能正前往君士坦丁堡或那不勒斯，他必须抓紧时间。

sentences.en: So the very next day, the 30th, he says, we're not waiting any more time in Alexandria.
sentences.zh: 所以在第二天，即30日，他说，我们不能在亚历山大港浪费时间了。

sentences.en: We have to get out and get on with the hunt.
sentences.zh: 我们必须离开，继续搜寻。

sentences.en: And they, they make sail and unbelievably, one day and one hour later, Bonaparte sails into Alexandria.
sentences.zh: 他们扬帆起航，难以置信的是，就在一天零一个小时后，拿破仑驶入了亚历山大港。

sentences.en: And this, of course, is one of the pivotal moments in world history.
sentences.zh: 当然，这是世界历史上的关键时刻之一。

sentences.en: It's a moment where you could say the age of European imperialism really begins.
sentences.zh: 这是一个可以说是欧洲帝国主义时代真正开端的时刻。

sentences.en: This is where the 19th century, perhaps in global terms, starts.
sentences.zh: 也许从全球范围来看，19世纪正是从这里开始的。

sentences.en: And we have already done an episode on it, haven't we?
sentences.zh: 我们已经做过一期关于它的节目了，不是吗？

sentences.en: We did an episode on Napoleon in Egypt.
sentences.zh: 我们做过一期关于拿破仑在埃及的节目。

sentences.en: And it's an incredible story.
sentences.zh: 这是一个不可思议的故事。

sentences.en: So for Napoleon, attacking Egypt is an attack on Britain.
sentences.zh: 对拿破仑来说，进攻埃及就是进攻英国。

sentences.en: So he describes that expedition as being the left wing of the army of England.
sentences.zh: 因此他将这次远征描述为英国远征军的左翼。

sentences.en: To destroy England thoroughly, we must seize Egypt because then they can throttle Britain's trade with India and maybe win India.
sentences.zh: 为了彻底摧毁英国，我们必须占领埃及，因为那样他们就能扼杀英国对印度的贸易，并可能赢得印度。

sentences.en: That's the way Napoleon thinks, to get at Britain.
sentences.zh: 这就是拿破仑的思维方式，旨在打击英国。

sentences.en: But it's also much more than that.
sentences.zh: 但这远不止于此。

sentences.en: The fantasy of being a new Alexander is playing in Napoleon's mind.
sentences.zh: 成为一个新亚历山大的幻想正在拿破仑的脑海中盘旋。

sentences.en: In his cabin, he has a huge library full of books, you know, the books of Greek and Roman history that he had so loved as a boy.
sentences.zh: 在他的船舱里，有一个装满书的大型图书馆，你知道的，都是他小时候非常喜欢的希腊和罗马历史书籍。

sentences.en: He's reading them through to inspire him.
sentences.zh: 他把这些书读了一遍又一遍来激励自己。

sentences.en: He literally sees himself as the new Alexander the Great.
sentences.zh: 他真的把自己看作是新的亚历山大大帝。

sentences.en: So I saw myself marching to Asia, mounted on an elephant, a turban on my head, and in my hand, a new Quran that I would have composed to suit my needs.
sentences.zh: 因此，我看到自己骑着大象向亚洲进军，头上缠着头巾，手里拿着一本为了迎合我的需要而自己编撰的新《古兰经》。

sentences.en: So we talked about Nelson being histrionic and operatic.
sentences.zh: 所以我们之前讨论过纳尔逊的做作和歌剧化。

sentences.en: I mean, Napoleon is of a different order.
sentences.zh: 我是说，拿破仑完全是另一个级别的。

sentences.en: But there is also the fact that this is an expedition that will open the eyes of Europe to the reality of Egypt.
sentences.zh: 但还有一个事实，即这是一次将向欧洲睁开双眼、展现埃及现实的远征。

sentences.en: Egypt as an Islamic country that can be studied in the way that savants might study, you know, plants or wildlife or whatever.
sentences.zh: 埃及作为一个伊斯兰国家，可以用学者研究植物、野生动物或其他事物的那种方式来进行研究。

sentences.en: But also, of course, the great center of pharaonic history.
sentences.zh: 当然，它也是法老历史的伟大中心。

sentences.en: And this is why Napoleon is taking savants with him.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么拿破仑要带着学者们同行。

sentences.en: It's an expedition, not just of imperial conquest, but of the Enlightenment laying claim to the study of the world.
sentences.zh: 这不仅是一次帝国的征服，也是一次启蒙运动对世界研究的主权宣示。

sentences.en: And so, you know, you might well say that that's also an imperial project.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，你完全可以说这也是一个帝国项目。

sentences.en: So he takes teams of savants with him, philosophers.
sentences.zh: 因此他带上了成队的学者、哲学家。

sentences.en: He takes a printing press that he'd nicked from the Vatican, which can print in Latin, in Arabic and Syriac.
sentences.zh: 他带了一台从梵蒂冈顺来的印刷机，可以印刷拉丁文、阿拉伯文和叙利亚文。

sentences.en: And he even takes a hot air balloon.
sentences.zh: 他甚至带了一个热气球。

sentences.en: I mean, it is an extraordinary story.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这是一个非凡的故事。

sentences.en: And if you have any interest in it and haven't heard the episode that we did when, about three years ago, I think, something like that, do listen to that.
sentences.zh: 如果你对它感兴趣，并且还没有听过我们大约三年前左右做过的那期节目，一定要去听听。

sentences.en: I slightly perhaps underplayed the military dimensions of this.
sentences.zh: 我可能稍微有点轻描淡写了其中的军事维度。

sentences.en: I mean, so he's brought 40,000 soldiers.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他带了四万名士兵。

sentences.en: He's got 20,000 sailors.
sentences.zh: 他有两万名水手。

sentences.en: This is an enormous amphibious expedition.
sentences.zh: 这是一次极其庞大的两栖远征。

sentences.en: And very successful because it takes him three weeks.
sentences.zh: 而且非常成功，因为只花了三个星期。

sentences.en: And three weeks after landing, he smashes the Mameluke army at the Battle of the Pyramids.
sentences.zh: 在登陆三星期后，他在金字塔战役中粉碎了马穆鲁克军队。

sentences.en: Yes, soldiers.
sentences.zh: 没错，士兵们。

sentences.en: What is it?
sentences.zh: 怎么说来着？

sentences.en: Something 4,000 years of history gazed down upon you.
sentences.zh: “四千年的历史在俯视着你们。”

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: Words to that thing.
sentences.zh: 差不多是这样的话。

sentences.en: I mean, he too, of course, Napoleon too, regards himself as an operatic figure.
sentences.zh: 我是说，当然，他自己、拿破仑也把自己视为一个歌剧中的人物。

sentences.en: And I mean, that's the joy of this story, actually.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这其实正是这个故事的乐趣所在。

sentences.en: I can't think of many moments in history that really match it, where everybody is conscious of that.
sentences.zh: 我想不出历史上有多少时刻能与之匹敌，每个人都意识到这一点。

sentences.en: They're playing a part on the greatest stage of all.
sentences.zh: 他们在最大的舞台上扮演着角色。

sentences.en: And on the 24th of July, he marches into Cairo.
sentences.zh: 7月24日，他开进开罗。

sentences.en: He is now the master of Egypt.
sentences.zh: 他现在成了埃及的主人。

sentences.en: So Napoleon, it seems, has won.
sentences.zh: 所以，拿破仑似乎赢了。

sentences.en: Now, meanwhile, Nelson has been sailing east, still searching for this fleet.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，纳尔逊一直在向东航行，仍在搜寻这支舰队。

sentences.en: He cruised along the coast of Turkey, and then he turned back east towards Sicily.
sentences.zh: 他沿着土耳其海岸巡航，然后向东折返驶向西西里。

sentences.en: At this point, he's running out of supplies, fruit and water.
sentences.zh: 此时，他的补给、水果和水都快耗尽了。

sentences.en: They head back towards Sicily.
sentences.zh: 他们启程返回西西里。

sentences.en: They stop at Syracuse.
sentences.zh: 他们在锡拉库扎停靠。

sentences.en: Here, they get new intelligence from Naples.
sentences.zh: 在这里，他们从那不勒斯得到了新的情报。

sentences.en: The French have not passed Naples.
sentences.zh: 法国人没有经过那不勒斯。

sentences.en: They have not gone through into the Western Mediterranean.
sentences.zh: 他们没有穿过西地中海。

sentences.en: They have not landed in Italy.
sentences.zh: 他们没有在意大利登陆。

sentences.en: They've definitely gone eaSt.
sentences.zh: 他们绝对是去东方了。

sentences.en: Again, it's probably about this point that Nelson has his captains for dinner, and he says, you know, time is running out.
sentences.zh: 同样，大概正是在这个时候，纳尔逊请他的舰长们共进晚餐，他说，时间不多了。

sentences.en: But I think we've clearly narrowed down, they must be somewhere out there in the eaSt.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们已经明确缩小了范围，他们一定在东方的那片海域的某个地方。

sentences.en: And when we find them, this is what we will do.
sentences.zh: 当我们找到他们时，我们就这么做。

sentences.en: It's not Admiral Hotham.
sentences.zh: 这不是霍瑟姆海军上将。

sentences.en: It's not a blockade.
sentences.zh: 这不是封锁。

sentences.en: Well, we attack them.
sentences.zh: 我们要进攻他们。

sentences.en: We go straight at them.
sentences.zh: 直接冲向他们。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And wipe them off the face of the sea.
sentences.zh: 把他们从大海上彻底抹去。

sentences.en: And this is unusual at the time, right?
sentences.zh: 这在当时很不寻常，对吧？

sentences.en: We talked in previous episodes.
sentences.zh: 我们在之前的节目中讨论过。

sentences.en: Becoming less unusual, I think, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 我想，这变得越来越不寻常了，不是吗？

sentences.en: Nelson is drawing on Captain Locker and, you know, Admiral Hood and all of these people who have been his great patrons.
sentences.zh: 纳尔逊借鉴了洛克船长、胡德海军上将以及所有这些一直以来慷慨资助他的前辈们的做法。

sentences.en: St. Vincent had done it.
sentences.zh: 圣文森特就这么干过。

sentences.en: St. Vincent had done it.
sentences.zh: 圣文森特就这么干过。

sentences.en: But he says, look, this is what we're doing.
sentences.zh: 但他说，听着，这就是我们要做的。

sentences.en: It is all or nothing.
sentences.zh: 要么全有，要么全无。

sentences.en: We risk everything.
sentences.zh: 我们孤注一掷。

sentences.en: We just go for it.
sentences.zh: 我们放手一搏。

sentences.en: An aggressive strategy.
sentences.zh: 一种进攻性的战略。

sentences.en: And the aim is a battle of annihilation, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 目标是一场歼灭战，不是吗？

sentences.en: If they can wipe out the French fleet, then Napoleon's military victory on land will count for nothing.
sentences.zh: 如果他们能消灭法国舰队，那么拿破仑在陆地上的军事胜利将毫无意义。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: They'll be stranded there.
sentences.zh: 他们将被困在那里动弹不得。

sentences.en: So a strategy in which we have an overall plan, but within that you have a degree of discretion and to use your initiative.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个既有总体规划，但在其中又给予一定自由裁量权并要求发挥主动性的战略。

sentences.en: I mean, he trusts his captains.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他信任他的舰长们。

sentences.en: His captains are delighted.
sentences.zh: 他的舰长们欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: And after four days, they set off again.
sentences.zh: 四天后，他们再次启程。

sentences.en: They're drilling now with their guns all the time.
sentences.zh: 他们现在随时都在进行火炮演练。

sentences.en: But of course, they still don't know where he is, where Napoleon is.
sentences.zh: 但当然，他们仍然不知道他在哪儿，拿破仑在哪儿。

sentences.en: No, itching for battle.
sentences.zh: 没有，他们渴望一战。

sentences.en: There is a real sense of mounting tension now because time is so short.
sentences.zh: 由于时间紧迫，现在有一种真正山雨欲来的紧张感。

sentences.en: They get letters from London and Elton opens one of them and a diplomat says to him, the eyes of all Europe are upon you.
sentences.zh: 他们收到了来自伦敦的信件，埃尔顿打开其中一封，一位外交官对他说：“全欧洲的目光都集中在你身上。”

sentences.en: You know, you've got to do this now.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你现在必须这么做。

sentences.en: They return to Greece.
sentences.zh: 他们返回希腊。

sentences.en: They reach a place called Koroni at the very bottom tip of the Peloponnese.
sentences.zh: 他们到达了一个叫科罗尼的地方，位于伯罗奔尼撒半岛的最南端。

sentences.en: And Truebridge goes ashore to find information and he comes back within hours and he's bursting with news.
sentences.zh: 特鲁布里奇上岸打探消息，几个小时内他就回来了，满心欢喜地带着消息。

sentences.en: He says, the Ottoman governor says he has had definite confirmation.
sentences.zh: 他说，奥斯曼总督说他得到了确切的证实。

sentences.en: They are in Alexandria after all.
sentences.zh: 他们毕竟还是在亚历山大港。

sentences.en: So again, Nelson turns south and he spreads his sails to catch the wind.
sentences.zh: 于是纳尔逊再次调头向南，扬帆起航借风前行。

sentences.en: He can't sleep.
sentences.zh: 他彻夜难眠。

sentences.en: He's pacing the quarter deck.
sentences.zh: 他在后甲板上踱来踱去。

sentences.en: And they rush and they rush at 10 a.m.
sentences.zh: 他们全速前进，在8月1日上午

sentences.en: on the 1st of AuguSt.
sentences.zh: 10点钟全速冲刺。

sentences.en: The lookout on the Alexander spies in the horizon, the kind of telltale gray blur of land.
sentences.zh: “亚历山大”号的瞭望员在海平线上进行侦察，那是陆地特有的模糊灰影。

sentences.en: And within, you know, an hour or so, news comes to Nelson.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道的，在大约一个小时之内，消息就传到了纳尔逊那里。

sentences.en: There are French tricolor flags flying over Alexandria.
sentences.zh: 亚历山大港上空飘扬着法国的三色旗。

sentences.en: There are French transports in the harbor.
sentences.zh: 港里停泊着法国的运输船。

sentences.en: Empty.
sentences.zh: 空空如也。

sentences.en: The French army has landed and has moved on.
sentences.zh: 法军已经登陆并向前开进。

sentences.en: Egypt has fallen.
sentences.zh: 埃及陷落了。

sentences.en: And one of Nelson's captains said later that at that moment, they felt, quote, utterly hopeless and out of spirits.
sentences.zh: 纳尔逊的一位船长后来回忆说，当时他们感到，引用他的话说，“彻底绝望，情绪低落”。

sentences.en: They've been pursuing the French for hundreds of miles.
sentences.zh: 他们追击法军已经数百英里。

sentences.en: They've pushed their ships and their men to the limit and they have failed.
sentences.zh: 他们把战舰和船员逼到了极限，但他们失败了。

sentences.en: The French have got the foothold in Egypt they wanted.
sentences.zh: 法军已经在埃及站稳了脚跟，达到了他们的目的。

sentences.en: And of course, there's the risk, isn't there, that the fleet will have gone somewhere safer?
sentences.zh: 当然，还有一种风险，不是吗，那就是舰队会去更安全的地方？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: That's the one crumb of consolation, the one possibility of redemption.
sentences.zh: 那是唯一的一点安慰，唯一能挽回局面的可能。

sentences.en: The one flickering of hope.
sentences.zh: 唯一的一丝希望之光。

sentences.en: The last flicker of hope exactly is if they can find that French fleet.
sentences.zh: 没错，最后一线希望就是他们能否找到那支法国舰队。

sentences.en: Just maybe the French admiral may have taken the fleet down the coast and parked it in a harbor closer to Cairo.
sentences.zh: 也许法国舰队司令会把舰队开到沿海，停在离开罗更近的一个港口。

sentences.en: If they can get it and destroy it, then everything Bonaparte would have done will be for nothing
sentences.zh: 如果他们能找到并消灭它，那么拿破仑所做的一切都将白费，

sentences.en: because the French army will be stranded and cut off from supplies and his conquests will just be, you know, ephemeral.
sentences.zh: 因为法军将陷入困境，切断补给，他的征服也将变得，你知道的，转瞬即逝。

sentences.en: And Dominic, just to say that the French high command in the Navy had wanted to withdraw, they'd wanted to withdraw to the Ionian islands, but Napoleon has said no.
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，顺便说一下，法国海军最高指挥部曾希望撤退，他们想撤到伊奥尼亚群岛，但拿破仑拒绝了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it's, well, we'll find out in the next episode whether it's a fateful mistake or not.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，我们将在下一集中揭晓这是否是一个命运攸关的错误。

sentences.en: So Nelson says to the captains of the Zealous and the Goliath, just quickly head east along the coaSt.
sentences.zh: 于是纳尔逊对“热心”号和“巨人”号的船长说，立刻沿海岸向东驶去。

sentences.en: It won't take long.
sentences.zh: 花不了多长时间。

sentences.en: We know from our charts, there's a deep harbor at Abu Keir Bay, which is quite close to the mouth of the Nile.
sentences.zh: 根据海图我们知道，在阿布基尔湾有一个深水港，离尼罗河口很近。

sentences.en: Just have a look.
sentences.zh: 去看一眼。

sentences.en: Down along the coast they go eaSt.
sentences.zh: 他们沿着海岸向东进发。

sentences.en: And at two o'clock that afternoon, they approach the delta of the Nile.
sentences.zh: 当天下午两点，他们接近了尼罗河三角洲。

sentences.en: And at 2.30, a midshipman, 16 years old, George Eliot, not the novelist, obviously, is on the highest yards of the Goliath with a telescope to his eye.
sentences.zh: 下午两点半，一个16岁的见习军官乔治·艾略特——显然不是那个小说家——拿着望远镜登上了“巨人”号最高的横桁。

sentences.en: And then he sees something in the distance.
sentences.zh: 接着他在远处看到了一个东西。

sentences.en: It's like the scene from Master and Commander, 13 ships of the line, four frigates, five brigs and bomb vessels, their French flags fluttering in the breeze.
sentences.zh: 就像电影《怒海争锋》里的场景，13艘战列舰、4艘巡洋舰、5艘双桅船和炮舰，法国国旗在微风中飘扬。

sentences.en: Tom, they have found them.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，他们找到了。

sentences.en: What a cliffhanger.
sentences.zh: 真是个扣人心弦的悬念。

sentences.en: And in the final episode of this season, we will tell the story of what happens next.
sentences.zh: 在本季的最后一集里，我们将讲述接下来发生的故事。

sentences.en: The Battle of the Nile.
sentences.zh: 尼罗河海战。

sentences.en: And if you just can't wait, then you can head to therestlesshistory.com to join the club.
sentences.zh: 如果你实在等不及，可以访问 therestlesshistory.com 加入俱乐部。

sentences.en: Obviously, if you're already a subscriber, like Nelson, go straight in.
sentences.zh: 显然，如果你已经是订阅者，就像纳尔逊一样，直接进入。

sentences.en: Don't delay.
sentences.zh: 不要耽搁。

sentences.en: England expects.
sentences.zh: 英国期待。

sentences.en: Goodbye.
sentences.zh: 再见。
